name: Feature Promotion
description: Internal TechGuilds recipe: skills-first promotion of shipped Kajoo work with five agents and approval gates. The promotion-artifact skill creates one artifact, run folder and Collect phase per run. The researcher reads a Jira release, epic or story into fact sheets; the orchestrator recommends a shortlist, and later phases are created only after the user approves it. Each approved entry gets a writer draft and an independent reviewer check against its tickets, then separate approvals of the exact text, an optional demo clip recorded in the sandbox on the stage demo organization and played in the chat before it is approved, the hidden ReadMe changelog entry and the public step. Approvals are tied to the hashes of the files they cover, so an edit after approval blocks publishing until it is approved again. Uses native workspace tools, the shared workflow and task-management skills, and small tested scripts. Run with Default approval only. Keep this recipe Hidden in the Kajoo library.
